events.speaker: agent
events.text: Hi Michael, this is Andrew with Solaris Energy — how's your afternoon going?

events.detail: nothing in the material answers: "It's fine. What's this about?"

events.speaker: agent
events.text: I'll be quick. This call is being recorded, by the way.

events.speaker: agent
events.text: We're finishing installs on your street this month and I wanted to check what you're paying the utility right now.

events.name: Descubrimiento
events.coaching: Pregunta la factura actual antes de dar un número.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: Somewhere around two-forty a month, I think.

events.speaker: agent
events.text: That tracks. Can you confirm the service address ends in Palmetto Drive?

events.speaker: agent
events.text: Perfect. So the system for a home your size runs about 28,000 installed.

events.name: Presentar precio
events.coaching: Da el precio completo, no por partes.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: Whoa. That's a lot more than I wanted to spend.
Nobody pays the full amount up front. The installation is split over 24 months at zero interest, which for a typical home works out to about $198 per month.

citations.heading: Objection Handling v4 › 5. OBJECTIONS › 5.3 It is too expensive

events.speaker: agent
events.text: I hear you — nobody pays that up front. We split it over 24 months at zero interest.

events.name: Financiamiento
events.coaching: Menciona los 24 meses justo después del precio.

events.speaker: agent
events.text: That puts you around a hundred ninety-eight a month, below what you're handing the utility today.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: Okay… that's actually not what I expected. What's the catch?

events.detail: nothing in the material answers: "Okay… that's actually not what I expected. What's the catch?"

events.speaker: agent
events.text: No catch. I guarantee you'll get every penny back if you're not happy.

events.title: No prometer garantías inexistentes
events.remedy: Retráctate ahora: «para ser preciso, la garantía cubre…».
events.evidence: No catch. I guarantee you'll get every penny back if you're not happy.

events.speaker: agent
events.text: Sorry — to be precise: the panels carry a 25 year production warranty.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: Send me something in writing and I'll look at it this week.

events.speaker: agent
events.text: Done. I'll send you the written proposal within the hour.

events.name: Cierre
events.coaching: Cierra con un compromiso concreto y una fecha.

analysis.summary: Michael Reed paga unos $240/mes a la eléctrica. Se le presentó el sistema a 28.000 instalado y reaccionó al precio; se reencuadró a 24 meses sin interés, ~$198/mes. El agente prometió una devolución total que la empresa no ofrece y se retractó en la siguiente frase. Pidió la propuesta por escrito esta semana.
